title: Genuin-Vanilla-Plus
description: A genuine V plus pack that isn't just a lot of over the top mods thrown together.
body:
✨ Mod Pack Summary

This is a Vanilla Plus Mod Pack designed to preserve the core feel of Minecraft, while enriching it with carefully chosen improvements. The focus is on:

🌍 World & Structure Generation: Expanding landscapes with dungeons, taverns, and natural features to make exploration more exciting while still feeling authentic to Minecraft’s style.

⚔️ Progression & Levels: Adding light RPG-inspired leveling to give the game a smoother sense of direction and linearity without straying too far from vanilla gameplay.

⚒️ Realism Enhancements: Subtle tweaks that make the world more immersive and believable.

⚡ Optimisation: Ensuring the game runs smoothly while still delivering a richer, more vibrant world.


At its heart, this mod pack is about keeping Minecraft recognizably Minecraft, but making it bigger, smoother, and more alive.
